caption:
MUSHROOM FRICASSEE RECIPE! 🍄

This recipe is an absolute game changer for those nights you need to host a party!! 
Comes together in under 10 minutes and has your guests always going back for seconds, thirds and forths 😉 

Ingredients:
1 packet of button mushrooms sliced OR finely chopped
6 cloves of garlic, finely minced
1 medium onion, finely diced
pinch of salt and pepper
½ cup of half cream and ½ milk
2 packets of origano, 1 packet of chilli flakes
Cheese as per your preference ;)
Optional: 1 green chilly, finely spiced
